original:
अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाऽहिंसा परं तपः ।
अहिंसा परमं सत्यं यतो धर्मः प्रवर्तते ॥
sanskrit:
अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाऽहिंसा परं तपः ।
अहिंसा परमं सत्यं यतो धर्मः प्रवर्तते ॥
transliteration:
ahiṃsā paramo dharmas tathā'hiṃsā paraṃ tapaḥ |
ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyaṃ yato dharmaḥ pravartate ||
translation: Non-violence is the highest virtue, non-violence is the highest austerity, non-violence is the highest truth from which all righteousness proceeds.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: अहिंसा परम धर्म है, अहिंसा परम तप है, और अहिंसा ही परम सत्य है जिससे सम्पूर्ण धर्म प्रवृत्त होता है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: अहिंसा हाच श्रेष्ठ धर्म आहे, अहिंसा हेच श्रेष्ठ तप आहे आणि अहिंसा हेच परम सत्य आहे ज्यातून सर्व धर्म प्रवृत्त होतो.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: In the Vana Parva discourses, Markandeya and Yudhishthira reaffirm that Ahimsa is the supreme metaphysical anchor of cosmic harmony.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Spoken during the Pandavas' 12-year forest exile, synthesizing the highest ascetic morality with royal duty.
